specoment_defects_found.subject: registry class confusion would destroy accumulated evidence

Four registries - evidence, waivers, releases, compatibility - are accumulated state sourced from test runs, approvals and shipped artefacts, not projections of the root. Confirmed against the frozen baseline: specs/registry/evidence.json holds 52 records with gate-invocation sources; waivers.json holds approver, approval_role, expires and blocked_milestone. Section 0.4's implementation-maturity enum is Implemented, ImplementedFoundation, StructuralSmoke, Partial, Transitional, Scaffold, Planned, Research, Deferred, Unsupported. ExistingUnqualified is not among them and appears only twice in the document, both inside this phase card and its Appendix G serialization.
specoment_defects_found.found: by the drafting agent while pre-verifying its own plan figures
specoment_defects_found.disposition: The census emits card_disposition (verbatim ExistingUnqualified) and implementation_maturity (null, with a note that no 0.4 value has been earned under v1 evidence). Projecting it as a 0.4 value would invent a status, which PH-AUTH-003's stop condition forbids; projecting a 0.4 value instead would assert maturity the card refuses to grant.

specoment_defects_found.subject: artefacts derived from the source tree are a third class
specoment_defects_found.detail: SD-011 split artefacts into root projections (class a, policed by byte-identity against the specoment digest) and accumulated state (class b, policed by conformance). A census is neither: derived, so not (b); derived from cargo metadata and the source tree rather than from the specoment, so not (a). Placing it in emit::all() would invert its staleness key, make project --check machine-dependent through absolute manifest paths, contaminate governance/manifest.json, and make Appendix D rules 2 and 6 unsatisfiable since crate names are not specoment stable IDs.
specoment_defects_found.disposition: Class (c) established: lives under .meridian/implementation/, schema under governance/schemas/, stamped with a source_tree_checkpoint and policed by regeneration.

corrections.subject: '731 declared, 0 undeclared - the specoment is index-clean'
corrections.detail: Stated to the owner and written into the WP-V1-RESET-002 source diagnosis. Wrong on both halves. Verified truth: 735 declared, 700 indexed, 0 real duplicates, 0 undeclared. 35 canonical identifiers are indexable zero times. Surfaced by independent review challenging the figure; confirmed by direct measurement.

corrections.subject: dependency reasoning in WP-V1-RESET-002 revision 3
corrections.detail: Argued against taking regex and sha2 by citing LEGAL-005's provenance burden. LEGAL-006 (line 15824) states Meridian 'does not pursue dependency elimination as a goal in itself' and closes "'We could write it ourselves' is not sufficient justification for replacement." Citing the paperwork clause to avoid a dependency while omitting its immediate neighbour forbidding that posture was a one-sided reading of the governing authority. Argument withdrawn; both decisions re-derived on LEGAL-006's own grounds. The conclusions did not change, the reasoning did.

corrections.subject: SD-006 and the RG prefix
corrections.detail: Removed RG from the retired-v0.5 prefix list on the reasoning that RG-TOR-001 appears in a live v1 section, and reported it as an undeclared identifier blocking PH-AUTH-002's closure row. That was wrong and was escalated to the owner as OD-008 before being checked against the frozen baseline, which holds a complete v0.5 record for the identifier. Reverted; OD-008 withdrawn.
corrections.lesson: The escalation was premature. The check that settled it - grep the frozen v0.5 registry - was available the whole time and took one command.

corrections.subject: coverage matrix disposition derivation
corrections.detail: derive() answered per check rather than per identifier, dropping 64 of 66 units as v05-authority-retired. Fourteen of those police concepts that survive into v1 - duplicate-id, work-package-cycle, broken-link, expired-waiver, false-promotion among them. The matrix was licensing a silent capability loss, which is the precise failure it exists to prevent.
corrections.found: by the drafting agent, while preparing the PH-AUTH-004 plan for review
corrections.disposition: Derivation rewritten per identifier. Seven units now carry Superseded dispositions each naming the fixture that demonstrates the v1 successor catches the case; ten escalate as OD-010.

corrections.subject: PH-AUTH-004 closure row and the docs measurement
corrections.detail: The plan claimed 'no active file declares v0.5 authority, asserted by a rule'. No rule existed, and the claim was false: once one was written it found 60 files, including 32 ADRs carrying 'Spec version: v0.5' at authority rank 2 and 17 benchmark headers. Separately, the docs figure was made correct by narrowing the grep criterion rather than by doing the work - the narrowed criterion returned 38 both before and after the re-citation pass, so the number had never moved.
corrections.disposition: Rule implemented and wired into check with two fixture tests; 60 reduced to 0. The measurement is now produced by the rule rather than by a hand-tuned grep.

corrections.subject: merge authorization inference
corrections.detail: Read the /goal directive as an explicit grant to merge, on the reasoning that PH-AUTH-004's definition is a merge. IMPL-SCM-001 gates on 'explicitly granted that action', and deriving a grant from a phase's scope is implicit by definition. The reductio is in this repository: the same phase's closure row needs fresh-checkout CI, which needs a push, and OD-005 exists precisely because push was NOT inferred from the same directive.
corrections.disposition: Withdrawn. The merge requires an explicit owner grant.

corrections.subject: test function count
corrections.detail: Reported 716 test functions. The summing pipeline was piped through 'tail -30', so it totalled only the last thirty files. Two independent counting methods now agree at 772. Third instance in this programme of a figure being wrong because a pipeline silently truncated its own input.
corrections.disposition: Corrected to 772; every figure in the census plan now names the command that produced it.
